bot.tagTitle: A computer opponent: the Gym Leader plays for the ladder when no trainer is around

search.noneYet: No trainer found yet. Battle a Gym Leader?
search.botAbout: A computer opponent that plays at your division. Rated, at half the usual swing.

card.label: Ranked · World map
card.off: Ranked PokéGuessr opens soon. Casual duels are on: switch to Casual to find an opponent or duel a friend.
card.how1: Head to head on the world map. Climb from Poké Ball to Beast Ball against trainers near your Elo.
card.how2: The same places for you both, {hp} HP each: every round, the lower score loses the difference. Always the world map, every game. Leaving counts as a loss.
card.how3: Everyone starts at {start} Elo, rated as Pokémon Showdown rates battles: Poké Ball and Great Ball show your division only; from Ultra Ball up the number shows too. Ratings above {drift} drift down a little on days you don't play.
card.how4: You're matched with trainers near your Elo, further apart the longer you wait. If nobody turns up in {wait}, you can battle a Gym Leader instead: a clearly labelled computer opponent that plays at your division, rated at half the usual swing.
card.how5: Ranked runs in eight-week seasons. Your highest division in a season earns its rewards (a season badge, and cosmetics for every division up to it) when the season ends. Then every rating resets halfway toward {start}, down one division at most, so the climb starts again close to where you finished.

outcome.botNote: A Gym Leader duel: rated at half the usual swing.
